Query.Sql: select patient_identifier_value, clinical_date, clinical_datetime, clinical_code, case when length(trim(clinical_code)) >= 3 then upper(trim(clinical_code)) end as concept_code from ##duckdb_source## where upper(trim(clinical_code_system)) in ('ICD-10', 'ICD10')

Explanation.Description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.
Clinical procedure date. Missing dates produce invalid procedure records.
Original procedure code, preserved as the source value.

Uppercase, trimmed ICD10 code. Codes shorter than three characters are passed as null to the existing resolver, yielding unknown concept 0 rather than throwing. Only Procedure-domain targets are retained.
